Roadshow network headers (netinclude)

Source: NDK 3.2 Release 4, directory SANA+RoadshowTCP-IP/netinclude, copied
unchanged. Used at compile time only by C:Claude (llm/net_amiga.c) and
C:uptelnet (net/uptelnet.c); nothing here ships in the archives.

Licence: the Roadshow headers by Olaf Barthel are marked "Freely
Distributable". netinet/ip_nat.h and netinet/ip_fil.h are by Darren Reed and
permit redistribution provided the copyright notice in each file is kept.
inline4/bsdsocket.h is generated by idltool from the interface description.

Kept in the tree so the build does not depend on another project's checkout
(it used to fall back to DCTelnet's copy). Override with VTCON_NETINCLUDE=.
